reviews.t: Good but the little jars are better
reviews.x: I am in love with the Vaseline Rosy Lips little containers but hate having to use my finger to scoop the Vaseline out. However, it’s the best chapstick I’ve ever used (I have chronically dry lips, and this stuff keeps them moisturized like nothing else. And I have tried EVERYTHING.) So, I was hoping the stick format would’ve been just as amazing. Eh. Not the best, but still better than other stick chapsticks I’ve tried. Would recommend, but would recommend the little containers that are more Vas
This is not the same as what comes in the little Vaseline containers. Not nearly as moisturizing.

reviews.t: Not if you like the tub
reviews.x: I REALLY wanted to love the stick version  because I despise using my finger. That said, I haaaate the stick. It's in a drawer for emergencies only. (I rather use Classic Cherry Chapstick over this.) But yeah... The stick is bulky, formula is thick, soaks in way too fast & have to re-apply constantly. Wish it was the same as the tub formula. Feels like putting weird, goopy lotion on your lips. I think it's the shea butter in it maybe? Unfortunately, stickin to the tub, keeping my nail cut short

reviews.t: Great for fans of the Rosy Lips tub Vaseline, but NOT a tinted lip balm
reviews.x: Have had this for several weeks now, so I feel comfortable writing a review. I usually put some Rosy Lips Vaseline on before I do the rest of my skincare for the night, but over time got tired of touching the inside with my fingers. This is a great substitute and works just as well as the tub version. Once you break it in, it's not super waxy at all. The tube has a satisfying little click when you wind it all the way down, and so far I haven't had any problems with it not coming back down. Howev

I thought this would be a nice replacement for the Vaseline rosy lips tin, which I love. I woke up in the middle of the night with my lips itchy and burning. I stopped using it. A few days later and my lips are still hurting.

I have used this brand in the past but in the metal tin. I loved it but hated using my finger to apply it. So when I saw this I jumped at it. Love the faint fruity smell and the slight pink glossy tint it put on my lips. Very soothing to capped lips, no stinging, and very moisturizing. Only gave 4 stars because when I opened the one it was empty, it at least I thought it was. I looked in the car and the stuck was there. I tapped it out and stuck in the and pressed it slightly. reviews.t: Worth the money but don’t like the result
reviews.x: I got from local dollar store. I really love the smell and the light texture. It goes really thin and fade away really quick, I constantly need to reapply. After awhile of using it, my lip started to feel burning, itchy and have dead skin. I didn’t really pay attention to it until I switched to another brand that I used for years. Overall, I think it worth the money if you can find it in dollar store and your lip can tolerate it.

reviews.t: Nice, but I wish it had sun protection and just a bit more color.
reviews.x: The lip balm is nicely moisturizing.  The tint is negligible, so I wish it had a bit more color.  And it would have been nice to have some SPF protection, too.

I normally use baseline on my lips daily. I thought this would be a great solution to can't it around but it's not that great. It feels almost dry when applying it to the lips, it has little scent, no flavor, and adds practically no pigment. Personally I like my lips to look coated and shiny. I had to apply it for a good minute in order to get the results desired but it still felt dry. Not sure why since it has great ingredients .

I had this in the little tub for years and just discovered it in this tube form. The tube is easier and less messy to apply. The tube fits better in my purse and I don't have to be concerned with the top coming off. It's moisturizing and has a soft "non-lip-sticky" feel, color, and look. I feel it's also more sanitary to apply than dipping my finger in the tub. I use it daily with few reapplications.

reviews.t: I was expecting the rosy lip care small tub, but this is different!
reviews.x: This one is different from the typical rosy lip tin or tub. This chapstick isn't tinted, and it smells amazing, but it also isn't as dense as its Vaseline counterpart. So... if you are looking for something less thick, this is the one for you. I'm going to use this along with my aloe/rosy lips vaseline tins in the winter.

I am an avid chap stick user.  I tried this product recently and it is my new favorite.  It is lightweight and does not have a strong flavor or scent.  I also like the natural pink tone that enhances the natural color of my lips.  Would highly recommend!
It works well for moisturizing not as good as Chapstick if you have chapped lips. It has a little bit of a tent to it  that looks very natural. I’d like to use it at night before I go to bed.
Both of the green tubes came like this… damaged, messy, and disgusting. The chapstick was stuck in the cap and there was chapstick all over one of the caps. Gross.
Bought the product and the package was greasy. Tore it open and so was the product itself. Seems like it was in a hot box and melted. Waste of money

reviews.t: Apply in front of a mirror 😂😐🙄
reviews.x: Moisturizing, glides on smoothly. Just don’t forget that it’s tinted. I looked in the mirror and the Joker was looking back at me. 😳
Moisture does not last as long as others. Flavor is not what I like.

reviews.t: Bad quality than the others I buy in walgreen
reviews.x: First time opening it, directly fall apart

reviews.t: Low scent, low flavor. Highly moisturizing...My favorite chapstick!
reviews.x: Very moisturizing.. My favorite chapstick!

reviews.t: Rich, buttery, smells good, and feels good!
reviews.x: Vaseline makes the best lip salves and balms. Hands (or lips) down. I like the cocoa butter in this, but there are other options as well. I've got a couple of little tins of their balm but I've gotta use a finger for that, and don't want to carry that with me, so this stick fills that roll. I plan to get more of these, for both me and my guy. It's cold here in the heartland during winter, and chapped lips are a PITA. This stuff will prevent them and help any cracks to heal. If you get chapped ch

I used to be able to find the stick of Vaseline lip balm locally but they have vanished from all our local drug stores.  I was happy to find these on a search.  I used to get the plain stick but these are slightly tinted pink and actually do a decent job putting some color on my face.  I will be ordering more as winter really dries out my lips and these work to stop that.

This lip balm REALLY works, specially if you live in a rather dry weather. It feels a bit greasy at first but after about 5 minutes you do not feel it anymore. The only thing that I do not like is the taste. It does have a chemical sweet taste at first when you apply it but it goes a way after a few minutes. Overall, will buy again for sure.

I absolutely LOVE the potted rose Vaselines, but this is no where close in flavor or thickness. Obviously, this is a stick form, so it’ll be thinner but this barely coated my lips and had a weird flavor. It provided little to no moisture and left me searching for my potted Vaseline.

I have used many chapsticks. Some expensive and some from the dollar store. This is by far my favorite product. It can heal my chapped lips and literally just a few minutes. I feel instant relief when I put it on. I also love the slight tint it gives.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tube form convenient and less messy than the little tubs or tins, since they dislike scooping with their fingers.
Several reviewers say it is moisturizing and works well for dry lips, though some find it less moisturizing than the tub version.
Some reviewers report the formula is thin, fades quickly, and requires constant reapplication.
A few reviewers experienced itching, burning, or irritation after using it.
Some reviewers note the tint is negligible or not as expected, and wish it had more color or SPF.
